feature: Leads Excel/CSV import with auto-detected column mapping
action_items: Pre-existing, unrelated backend suite failures (test_tscheck_rekap_bulanan, test_tscheck_notifications_exclude_closed, test_tscheck_note_closes_lead_removes_notification, test_tscheck_reschedule_clears_notification) are failing because POST /leads now requires a 'no_wa' field while those older tests send 'no_hp'. Not part of the import feature under test in this iteration; flagging for main agent to fix or update those tests.

checks.criterion: Upload accepts a real .xlsx with non-template headers and auto-detects the mapping
checks.name: test_tscheck_import_preview_autodetect.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/leads/import/preview with real .xlsx (openpyxl) headers 'Nama Lengkap, No. HP / WhatsApp, Umur, Kota Domisili, Pekerjaan, Dari Mana Tahu, Kode Referensi' -> 200; mapping nama='Nama Lengkap', no_wa='No. HP / WhatsApp', usia='Umur', kota='Kota Domisili', profesi='Pekerjaan', sumber='Dari Mana Tahu', unmapped_headers=['Kode Referensi'].

checks.criterion: Mapping screen appears in the UI with the guess pre-filled and is editable
checks.name: import-mapping-screen-shows-detected-mapping
checks.evidence: As admin on /leads, Upload Excel/CSV opens dialog; uploading CSV with 7 headers shows import-preview-summary ('...csv · 1 baris · 7 kolom terbaca'), import-map-select-nama pre-set to 'Nama Lengkap', import-map-select-sumber pre-set to 'Dari Mana Tahu', import-leftover-columns names 'Kode Referensi', import-sample-table shows first row. Setting nama select to '— tidak dipakai —' surfaced import-missing-required and disabled import-confirm-button (also covers required-field guard UI).

checks.criterion: Confirming the mapping actually creates the leads
checks.name: import-confirm-creates-searchable-leads
checks.evidence: Uploaded CSV with a unique 'tscheck-import-confirm-<ts>' name, confirmed mapping, import-result showed '1 leads dibuat · 0 dilewati'; closed dialog, searched Nasabah table by name, row appeared, opened detail sheet.

checks.criterion: Confirming the mapping actually creates the leads (API)
checks.name: test_tscheck_import_confirm_creates_leads.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/leads/import with explicit mapping -> 200, created=1 skipped=0; GET /api/leads?type=nasabah&search=<name> -> 200, returns the created lead with matching kota.

checks.criterion: Unmapped columns are preserved as a progress note on each imported lead
checks.name: import-confirm-creates-searchable-leads
checks.evidence: Same flow: lead-detail-sheet lead-notes-timeline shows 'Data tambahan dari file import — Info Tambahan: REF-001'.

checks.criterion: Unmapped columns are preserved as a progress note on each imported lead (API)
checks.name: test_tscheck_import_progress_note.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/leads/import with 'Kode Referensi' left unmapped -> created=1; GET /api/leads/{id} notes[0].text starts with 'Data tambahan dari file import' and contains 'Kode Referensi: REF-001'.

checks.criterion: Admin's lead-type choice applies to every row when the file has no tipe column
checks.name: import-lead-type-applies-when-no-tipe-column
checks.evidence: Chose 'Pelamar Kerja' before uploading a tipe-less CSV; imported row absent from Nasabah tab (count 0) and present on Pelamar Kerja tab after switching.

checks.criterion: Admin's lead-type choice applies to every row when the file has no tipe column (API)
checks.name: test_tscheck_import_default_lead_type.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/leads/import lead_type='pelamar' with tipe-less file -> created=1; GET /api/leads?type=nasabah&search=<name> returns [], GET /api/leads?type=pelamar&search=<name> returns the row with type='pelamar'.

checks.criterion: Required-field guard blocks a bad mapping
checks.name: test_tscheck_import_required_field_guard.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/leads/import with mapping {"no_wa":"Umur"} (nama unresolved) -> 400. UI half covered inside import-mapping-screen-shows-detected-mapping (missing-required banner + disabled confirm button).

checks.criterion: Legacy template CSV still imports unchanged
checks.name: test_tscheck_import_legacy_template_backward_compat.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/leads/import-template -> 200 CSV; POSTed straight back to /api/leads/import with no mapping field -> 200, created=2 skipped=0 (backward compatibility with pre-mapping contract).

checks.criterion: Bad input and role scope are rejected
checks.name: test_tscheck_import_bad_input_and_role_scope.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/leads/import/preview with a .pdf -> 400 with Indonesian detail; no session -> 401; as rina@quickpro.id (marketing) -> 403.

checks.criterion: Bad input and role scope are rejected (Upload button admin-only, UI)
checks.name: import-upload-button-admin-only
checks.evidence: Logged in as rina@quickpro.id (marketing) on /leads: open-import-leads-button has count 0 (not rendered).
